title.en: An Act to Amend Section Fourteen Hundred and Ninety-Eight of Act Numbered Twenty-Eight Hundred and thirty-Five, Increasing the Tax on Playing Cards

text.en:
Section fourteen hundred and ninety-eight of Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and
thirty-five is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 1198. Tax on playing cards.- (1) On each pack of cards containing not more than fifty-eight cards,
there shall be collected a tax of one peso. (2) On each pack containing more than fifty-eight cards, there shall
be collected the tax established in the last preceding paragraph and a proportionate additional tax on the
number in excess of fifty-eight."

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, December 1, 1925.
